text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They're past the fourth corner and
heading into
the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (This is it! Now's the time for me to—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(My legs feel... heavy...
But now is when I
need to
make my move!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Aaand it's over! Satono Diamond takes
the gold! The storm has cleared, and the
sun has revealed a
brilliantly shining
diamond!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Nice job, Satono Diamond!
It's obvious
she's just getting started! I can't wait
to
see how she grows!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she looked a little shaky near the
end, but
it was a great performance
nonetheless!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something felt off about her
performance during the race. Satono
Diamond was clearly feeling
tired near
the end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She may have spent too much energy
running to
the racecourse earlier.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But it she hadn't done that, she wouldn't
have
made it in time for the race. Our
hands were tied,
but still...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(It took everything I had just to run all
2,000
meters of that race... I'm sure
everyone was able
to see that...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(The last section was so difficult to get
through. I
wasn't able to sprint properly
on the final stretch
at all...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(That was a far cry from how I wanted to
run...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(The Satsuki Sho is a race where only the
fastest
prevail, and that performance
was hardly one
befitting its victor!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I can hardly call myself illustrious
after
that!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! There's no need for you to
apologize!
choice_data_list: Sorry for making you run all the w...
Sorry for making you run all the w...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I thought getting out of the taxi and
running was
the best decision as well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm just upset the rotten weather
prevented me
from running at my very
best...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if this was also due to the
Satono jinx...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But even if it was...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I just need to break it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Japanese Derby! I'll
destroy the jinx there, pull off a perfect
performance, and
take first place for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's declaration rings with 
determination. This spate of misfortune
appears to have strengthened her
resolve to break the
jinx.
